rules.name: Speed!
rules.desc: Game ends before minute {k} with 8+ players.

rules.name: Gone in 360 Seconds
rules.desc: An 8v8 won by elimination in under {k} minutes.

rules.name: Short Work
rules.desc: The game is decided before minute {k} in a game of 8+ players.

rules.name: Lightning War
rules.desc: A side wins a game of 6+ players in under {k} minutes.

rules.name: Champion of Elysium
rules.desc: A side wins against an average OpenSkill {k}+ higher.

rules.name: Hard Mode
rules.desc: Win against a side whose average OpenSkill is {k}+ higher.

rules.name: Are You Not Entertained?
rules.desc: An 8v8 won in under {k} minutes.

rules.name: Turn of the Century
rules.desc: A game lasting over {k} minutes.

rules.name: Blitz
rules.desc: The game was decided before {k} minutes.

rules.name: Deep for Speed
rules.desc: A team game (6+ players) won by elimination in under {k} minutes.

rules.name: Nexus Blitz
rules.desc: Win in under {k} minutes in a team game.

rules.name: Warsong Expedience
rules.desc: Win a 1v1 in under {k} minutes.

rules.name: Let's Get This Done
rules.desc: Team game won in under {k} minutes.

rules.name: Kill Them All Before Nightfall
rules.desc: A game of 8+ players decided before minute {k}.

rules.name: Supremest Commander
rules.desc: A player wins against a side with a higher total rating by {k}+ points.

rules.name: Packed House
rules.desc: A game watched live by {k} or more spectators.

rules.name: Duel Upset
rules.desc: In a duel, the winner's OpenSkill was >= {k} lower than the loser's.

rules.name: Team Upset
rules.desc: The winning side's average rating was >= {k} lower than the loser's in a team game.

rules.name: Rookie Win
rules.desc: A player at chevron rank {k} or below (rank 0 is under 5 hours) was on the winning side of an 8v8 and dealt the most damage there.

rules.name: Veteran's Guidance
rules.desc: The winning side had both a rank 0 and a rank {k}+ player.

rules.name: United Nations
rules.desc: Players from >= {k} different countries in one game.

rules.name: National Team
rules.desc: Every player on the winning side is from the same country (>= {k} players).

rules.name: Blitzkrieg
rules.desc: A team game of >= 8 players won in under {k} minutes.

rules.name: Marathon Session
rules.desc: Game lasted >= {k} minutes.

rules.name: Equal Footing
rules.desc: Both sides' average rating within {k} in a >= 6-player game.

rules.name: Uncertain Future
rules.desc: A player with rating uncertainty >= {k} (new account) won a duel against an established player.

rules.name: Big Brain Lobby
rules.desc: The game's average rating is in the top 1% of all games of its size.

rules.name: Odd Odds
rules.desc: A side won while having fewer players (uneven teams from the startscript).

rules.name: Mod Explorer
rules.desc: A game with >= 5 non-default modoptions.

rules.name: Flip-Flop
rules.desc: A resign vote (!cv resign) that {k}+ players voted for fails, then their side wins the game.

rules.name: What a Save
rules.desc: Player chats 'what a save'/'nice shot' after an ally's loss.

rules.name: Map Artist
rules.desc: A player draws >= {k} map line segments in one game.

rules.name: Graffiti Artist
rules.desc: A player draws {k}+ line segments on the map in one game.

rules.name: Hello Cleveland!
rules.desc: The most chat-active player in a team game (by messages) also tops their side's kills.

rules.name: Media Blitz
rules.desc: A player sends {k}+ chat messages in a game.

rules.name: Communication Breakdown
rules.desc: A team game of {k}+ players where nobody on the losing side writes a single chat line or ping.

rules.name: Good Game
rules.desc: Every player in the game writes 'gg' in the last {k} minutes.

rules.name: Chatterbox
rules.desc: A player sends {k}+ chat messages in one game.

rules.name: Storyteller
rules.desc: A player writes {k} or more chat messages in one game.

rules.name: Unanimous GG
rules.desc: Every player in the game wrote 'gg' (or variants) in the last {k} minutes.

rules.name: GL HF
rules.desc: Every player wrote glhf/gl/hf in the first {k} minutes.

rules.name: Silent Victory
rules.desc: The winning side wrote no chat at all in a game >= {k} min.

rules.name: Hundred Messages
rules.desc: Player wrote >= {k} chat messages.

rules.name: Shot Caller
rules.desc: Player wrote the most ally chat and placed the most pings on their winning side.

rules.name: Freehand Painter
rules.desc: Player drew >= {k} line segments on the map.

rules.name: Ping Spammer
rules.desc: Player placed >= {k} map pings.

rules.name: Spectator Gallery
rules.desc: Spectators wrote >= {k} messages.

rules.name: Calm Under Fire
rules.desc: Player wrote nothing for the whole game and won as MVP by damage dealt.

rules.name: Commentator
rules.desc: A spectator wrote >= {k} messages.

rules.name: Team Meeting
rules.desc: Ally chat had >= {k} messages from >= 4 different players within 30 s.

rules.name: Polite Opponents
rules.desc: Both sides exchanged 'gl' and 'gg' in all-chat.

rules.name: Cursed Word
rules.desc: Someone wrote 'easy' in all-chat and their side lost.

rules.name: Sorry!
rules.desc: A player wrote 'sorry' or 'sry' >= {k} times.

rules.name: Shout of Victory
rules.desc: The first 'gg' of the game came from the losing side >= {k} min before the end.

rules.name: The Untouchables
rules.desc: A player wins a {k}+ minute game without losing a single unit.

rules.name: Human Wave
rules.desc: A side wins after losing {k} times as many units as it killed (count, not metal).

rules.name: Carnage I
rules.desc: One player kills {k} enemy units in one game.

rules.name: Carnage II
rules.desc: One player kills {k} enemy units in one game.

rules.name: Carnage III
rules.desc: One player kills {k} enemy units in one game.

rules.name: Carnage IV
rules.desc: One player kills {k} enemy units in one game.

rules.name: Carnage V
rules.desc: One player kills {k} enemy units in one game.

rules.name: Unit Preservation
rules.desc: Winner's losses are under {k}% of the loser's in a 20+ min game.

rules.name: Star Pupil
rules.desc: A player of rank {k} or below (rank 0: under 5 hours of play time) is on the winning side and dealt the most damage on it.

rules.name: Pacifist Economist
rules.desc: A player on the winning side whose units destroyed nothing but who produced the most metal on it.

rules.name: Did Everything
rules.desc: Top of their side in metal produced, damage dealt and units built, all at once.

rules.name: Underdog
rules.desc: The lowest-rated player in the lobby (OpenSkill) who dealt the most damage on their side.

rules.name: Dead God
rules.desc: A player is top in kills, economy and units built at once at the end, in a game of {k}+ players.

rules.name: Good Shepherd
rules.desc: A side wins with its lowest-rated player top in kills.

rules.name: Anyone Order a Pizza? I
rules.desc: A player finishes {k}+ units total in one game.

rules.name: Anyone Order a Pizza? II
rules.desc: A player finishes {k}+ units total in one game.

rules.name: Anyone Order a Pizza? III
rules.desc: A player finishes {k}+ units total in one game.

rules.name: Anyone Order a Pizza? IV
rules.desc: A player finishes {k}+ units total in one game.

rules.name: Anyone Order a Pizza? V
rules.desc: A player finishes {k}+ units total in one game.

rules.name: Pantheon
rules.desc: Highest-rated player who also had the most kills and the most metal spent, in a game of {k}+ players.

rules.name: Annihilation I
rules.desc: A game in which {k}+ units died.

rules.name: Annihilation II
rules.desc: A game in which {k}+ units died.

rules.name: Annihilation III
rules.desc: A game in which {k}+ units died.

rules.name: Annihilation IV
rules.desc: A game in which {k}+ units died.

rules.name: Annihilation V
rules.desc: A game in which {k}+ units died.

rules.name: Raptor Exterminator
rules.desc: In a Raptors game, a player kills {k} raptors (bronze from a quarter of that, gold at 2.5x).

rules.name: Scrapper
rules.desc: A side destroys >= {k} units in one game.

rules.name: Body Bagger
rules.desc: One player's kills exceed {k}% of all enemy units their side destroyed, in a 4+ player game.

rules.name: Spread Managed Democracy
rules.desc: A player kills {k}+ enemy units in one game.

rules.name: Pile 'Em Up
rules.desc: A side kills {k}+ units in one game.

rules.name: Explore, Expand, Exploit I
rules.desc: A player produces {k} million+ metal in one game.

rules.name: Explore, Expand, Exploit II
rules.desc: A player produces {k} million+ metal in one game.

rules.name: Explore, Expand, Exploit III
rules.desc: A player produces {k} million+ metal in one game.

rules.name: Golden Spurs
rules.desc: A player hands {k}+ units to allies in the first half of a game and keeps playing through the second.

rules.name: Command Economy
rules.desc: A player spends {k}k metal on builds in one game.

rules.name: Legions
rules.desc: A player finishes >= {k} units in one game.

rules.name: Gladiator
rules.desc: Highest-OpenSkill player in the game who also carried the most kills, in a game of {k}+ players.

rules.name: Top Producer
rules.desc: The player who produced the most metal in the game, if at least {k}x the next player.

rules.name: Thanatos Race
rules.desc: The two allies with the closest kill counts (within {k}) at the top of the side.

rules.name: Highest GPM
rules.desc: Player with the highest average metal income per minute; only if {k}x the next player.

rules.name: Splatted Most
rules.desc: The player with the most kills (by count) in the game.

rules.name: All Bark and All Bite
rules.desc: Player dealt >= {k}x the damage they received and >= 200k damage.

rules.name: Damage Sponge
rules.desc: Player received >= {k}% of their whole side's damage in a team game of >= 3 per side.

rules.name: Kill Leader
rules.desc: Player's kills are the highest in the game and >= {k}x the next player's.

rules.name: Five Hundred Club
rules.desc: Player's kills >= {k}.

rules.name: Thousand Cuts
rules.desc: Player's kills >= {k}.

rules.name: Thousand-Unit Factory
rules.desc: Player's units produced >= {k}.

rules.name: Workshop of the World
rules.desc: Player produced >= {k}% of the whole game's metal in a game of >= 8 players.

rules.name: Overflowing Coffers
rules.desc: Player's metal storage overflowed by >= {k}k.

rules.name: Not a Drop Wasted
rules.desc: Player produced >= 50k metal with under {k}% of it overflowing.

rules.name: Power Plant
rules.desc: Player's energy produced >= {k}M.

rules.name: Grid Dumper
rules.desc: Player's energy overflow >= {k}% of their energy produced and >= 500k.

rules.name: The Banker
rules.desc: Player sent >= {k}% of the metal they produced to allies, and >= 20k.

rules.name: Sugar Daddy
rules.desc: Player sent the most metal+energy in the game and >= {k}x what they received.

rules.name: Kept Alive
rules.desc: Player's metal received >= their own metal produced and >= {k}k: funded by allies.

rules.name: Inheritance
rules.desc: Player received >= {k} units: they took over a departed teammate's army.

rules.name: Body Snatcher
rules.desc: Player captured >= {k} units.

rules.name: Kidnapped
rules.desc: Player had >= {k} units captured by the enemy.

rules.name: Spend It All
rules.desc: Player spent >= {k}% of the metal they produced and received over a game >= 20 min.

rules.name: Cost Effective
rules.desc: Player's damage dealt per unit lost is the best in the game and >= {k}x their side's average.

rules.name: Kamikaze Squadron
rules.desc: Player lost >= {k}x as many units as they killed, with >= 300 lost.

rules.name: Untouchable Base
rules.desc: Player lost no unit in a game >= {k} min where their side won.

rules.name: Pure Economy
rules.desc: Player in a winning team dealt < {k}% of their side's damage and sent the most metal.

rules.name: Heavy Hitters
rules.desc: The winning side dealt <= {k}% of the losing side's damage: won while outdamaged.

rules.name: Lopsided
rules.desc: Winning side's units lost <= {k}% of the losing side's.

rules.name: Equal Exchange
rules.desc: Both sides' total damage taken within {k}% of each other in a game >= 30 min.

rules.name: Total War
rules.desc: Game's total units lost across all teams >= {k}.

rules.name: Billion Damage
rules.desc: Sum of damage dealt across the game >= {k}M.

rules.name: Carry
rules.desc: On the winning side, one player dealt >= {k}% of the side's damage in a team of >= 4.

rules.name: Pocket Economy
rules.desc: A player who dealt < 5% of their side's damage produced >= {k}% of its metal.

rules.name: Solar Flare
rules.desc: Player's energy produced is >= {k}x their metal produced (a pure energy role).

rules.name: Metal Baron
rules.desc: Player's metal produced is the highest in a game of >= 12 players and >= {k}x the second.

rules.name: Middleman
rules.desc: Player both received and sent >= {k}k metal: resources passed through them.

rules.name: Quality over Quantity
rules.desc: Player dealt the most damage in the game while building the fewest units on their side.

rules.name: Swarm Production
rules.desc: Player's units produced >= {k}x anyone else's in the game.

rules.name: Nothing Built
rules.desc: Player built <= {k} units in a game >= 15 min while still dealing >= 10% of their side's damage.

rules.name: Shared Wealth
rules.desc: Every player on the winning side sent and received >= {k}k metal: a fully pooled economy.

rules.name: Self-Sufficient
rules.desc: In a team game, a player sent and received 0 metal, 0 energy and 0 units.

rules.name: Outclassed and Outscored
rules.desc: Lowest-rated player in the game had the highest damage dealt, in a game of {k}+ players.

rules.name: Rookie Economist
rules.desc: A player of rank {k} or below produced the most metal on their side.

rules.name: Punching Up
rules.desc: Player dealt more damage than every higher-rated player (>= 8 players, they are in the bottom {k}% by rating).

rules.name: Improvised Carpentry
rules.desc: A player wins without building a single metal extractor.

rules.name: Slaughterhouse
rules.desc: A player self-destructs {k} or more of their own units within 10 seconds.

rules.name: Less Is More
rules.desc: Side wins while having fewer players (after leaves/resigns) than the enemy for the last {k}% of the game.

rules.name: Make It Quick
rules.desc: A game won before any player finished a tier-2 factory.

rules.name: Big Red Button
rules.desc: A player self-destructs >= {k} units within 10 s.

rules.name: Speed Climber
rules.desc: A 1v1 won by commander kill under {k} minutes.

rules.name: Suit Only
rules.desc: A player wins having built nothing but their commander's own construction and turrets: no factory ever ordered.

rules.name: Hold My Primary
rules.desc: A player wins without building any combat unit (eco/defences only, the commander does the rest).

rules.name: Cross-Faction
rules.desc: A player builds units of {k} different factions in one game (through a given or captured constructor).

rules.name: Raining Bullets
rules.desc: A side wins a game of >= {k} min without building a single static defence.

rules.name: The Path Not Taken
rules.desc: A side wins a {k}+ min game without ever building a T2 factory.

rules.name: Beginner's Luck
rules.desc: A side wins using only tech-1 units (no T2 factory finished).

rules.name: Guppy I
rules.desc: A player builds {k} different experimentals in one game.

rules.name: Guppy II
rules.desc: A player builds {k} different experimentals in one game.

rules.name: Insanity
rules.desc: A side wins with fewer players than the enemy (after a leaver) for {k}+ minutes.

rules.name: Getting Back to Nature
rules.desc: Win with your side never building beyond T1.

rules.name: Great Walls
rules.desc: A player builds {k}+ wall segments (dragon's teeth/fortification walls).

rules.name: All In
rules.desc: A winning player built no second factory all game.

rules.name: Titanic Terror
rules.desc: Both factions' flagship experimentals appear in the same game (Titan and Juggernaut).

rules.name: Surrender at 20
rules.desc: Side resigns within {k} s after minute 20.

rules.name: Before Our Time
rules.desc: A player builds a T2 unit before minute {k}.

rules.name: Technophobia
rules.desc: A side wins without ever building an air unit, against a side that did.

rules.name: Minimalist
rules.desc: A player wins having built {k} or fewer distinct unit types (economy excluded).

rules.name: Who Needs Relics?
rules.desc: A player wins with a single factory the entire game.

rules.name: Spore Loser
rules.desc: Win a game without ever building a nano turret.

rules.name: Who Needs Infantry?
rules.desc: A winning player built no bots (only vehicles/air/ships).

rules.name: Expand Everywhere
rules.desc: A player builds mexes in every quarter of the map.

rules.name: Engineering Upgrade
rules.desc: A player builds {k}+ factories in the first 3 minutes.

rules.name: No Towers Needed
rules.desc: A player wins having built no armed static defence in a game over {k} minutes.

rules.name: Terrif-eyeing
rules.desc: A player builds {k}+ radar towers/jammers/sonar.

rules.name: Ghoul Lumber
rules.desc: A player builds {k}+ energy storages.

rules.name: Field Marshal
rules.desc: A player on the winning side built no aircraft and no ships at all in a game over {k} minutes.

rules.name: Embargo
rules.desc: A side wins a {k}+ min game without building any metal or energy storage.

rules.name: Pole Position
rules.desc: The game is decided before any experimental is ordered, in a {k}+ minute game.

rules.name: Portal Conservation Society
rules.desc: A player wins having built {k} or fewer factory buildings in total in a 20+ min game.

rules.name: No Wheels
rules.desc: A winning side never built a long-range plasma cannon or nuke in a game of {k}+ min.

rules.name: No Time for Snoozing
rules.desc: A player starts building within {k} seconds of game start.

rules.name: Opening Gambit
rules.desc: Player's first 5 build orders match a named, common opening.

rules.name: Never Seen Before
rules.desc: Player's first 6 build orders form a sequence no one has used in the 2-year history.

rules.name: Speed Clicker
rules.desc: Player's actions per minute are the highest in the game and >= {k} averaged over the game.

rules.name: Zen Commander
rules.desc: Player won with the lowest actions per minute in the game and < {k} a minute.

rules.name: First Order
rules.desc: Player issued their first command within 1 s of game start, >= {k} s ahead of everyone.

rules.name: Slow Starter
rules.desc: Player issued no order for the first {k} s of the game and still won.

rules.name: Away from Keyboard
rules.desc: Player issued no orders for >= {k} consecutive minutes mid-game and came back to play.

rules.name: Tea Break
rules.desc: The game was paused for a total of >= {k} minutes.

rules.name: Pause Champion
rules.desc: One player paused the game >= {k} separate times.

rules.name: Mex Grabber
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} metal extractors in the first 4 minutes.

rules.name: Wind Farmer
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} wind turbines over the game.

rules.name: Solar Enthusiast
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} solar collectors and no wind turbines.

rules.name: The Great Wall
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} walls/dragon's teeth.

rules.name: Bunker Mentality
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} defensive structures and >= 50% of their build orders were defences.

rules.name: Factory Floor
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} different factory types in one game.

rules.name: One Lab Wonder
rules.desc: Player won while ordering exactly one factory all game in a game >= {k} min.

rules.name: Infinite Queue
rules.desc: Player queued >= {k} units in a single factory order batch.

rules.name: Nuclear Ambitions
rules.desc: Player ordered a nuclear silo.

rules.name: Doomsday Clock
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} nuclear silos.

rules.name: Shield Up
rules.desc: Player ordered an anti-nuke before any enemy ordered a nuke silo.

rules.name: Called the Nuke
rules.desc: Player ordered an anti-nuke within {k} minutes after an enemy ordered a nuke silo.

rules.name: Experimental Ambition
rules.desc: Player's build orders include >= {k} experimental units.

rules.name: Fastest T2
rules.desc: Player ordered their first T2 factory earlier than anyone in the game, and before {k}:00.

rules.name: Lightning Tech
rules.desc: Player ordered a T3 gantry before 12:00, the earliest on record for the map.

rules.name: Never Teched
rules.desc: Player won a game >= {k} min without ever ordering a T2 factory.

rules.name: Built at the Front
rules.desc: Player ordered a factory closer to the enemy start positions than to their own.

rules.name: Over the Midline
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} buildings beyond the map's midline toward the enemy.

rules.name: Corner Camper
rules.desc: All of a player's build orders were within {k} elmos of their start over a game >= 25 min.

rules.name: Sprawl
rules.desc: Player's build orders span >= {k}% of the map area (bounding box).

rules.name: Self-Destruct Sequence
rules.desc: Player self-destructed their commander.

rules.name: Self-Destruct Spree
rules.desc: Player ordered self-destruct on >= {k} units within 30 s (not as they left).

rules.name: Mass Reclaim
rules.desc: Player issued >= {k} reclaim orders.

rules.name: Patrol Planner
rules.desc: Player issued >= {k} patrol orders.

rules.name: Hold Fire
rules.desc: Player set hold-fire on units >= {k} times.

rules.name: Micro Manager
rules.desc: Player issued >= {k} move orders in a game.

rules.name: Macro Master
rules.desc: Player issued the most build orders in the game and >= {k}x their side's average.

rules.name: Click Storm
rules.desc: Player's peak 1-minute command count >= {k}.

rules.name: Selection Juggler
rules.desc: Player changed selection >= {k} times.

rules.name: The Long Pause
rules.desc: A single pause lasting >= {k} minutes.

rules.name: Unpause Diplomacy
rules.desc: The game was paused and unpaused by different players >= {k} times (pause wars).

rules.name: Gone Too Soon
rules.desc: A player left in the first {k} minutes and their team still won.

rules.name: Outnumbered and Winning
rules.desc: A side won after being a player down (a player left or dropped) for >= {k} minutes.

rules.name: Resign Vote Failed
rules.desc: A resign vote was called and failed, and that side went on to win.

rules.name: Not Yet
rules.desc: A player voted against resigning, and their side won.

rules.name: The Holdout
rules.desc: Last player of a resigning side to stay, issuing orders >= {k} minutes after teammates left.

rules.name: Graceful Exit
rules.desc: A side resigned unanimously within {k} s of the first resign vote.

rules.name: Reconnected
rules.desc: A player disconnected and came back in the same game, then won.

rules.name: Thirty Mex Spots
rules.desc: Player ordered metal extractors on >= {k} distinct spots.

rules.name: Mex Upgrader
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} T2 metal extractors.

rules.name: Fusion Age
rules.desc: Player ordered a fusion reactor before {k}:00.

rules.name: Converter King
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} energy converters.

rules.name: Three Hundred Wings
rules.desc: Player's air factory queue orders total >= {k} aircraft.

rules.name: Admiral's Order
rules.desc: Player queued >= {k} ships.

rules.name: Artillery Park
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} long-range plasma cannons or >= 2 rapid-fire ones.

rules.name: Bertha's Children
rules.desc: Player's first T2 structure order was a long-range gun.

rules.name: Unusual Choice
rules.desc: Player ordered a unit type used in < 1% of games in the 2-year history.

rules.name: Spam Specialist
rules.desc: One unit type accounts for >= {k}% of a player's factory queue (>= 100 units).

rules.name: Variety Pack
rules.desc: Player queued >= {k} distinct unit types.

rules.name: Identical Openings
rules.desc: Both players in a duel ordered the same first {k} builds.

rules.name: All-In
rules.desc: Player issued no build order for >= {k} minutes while issuing >= 200 attack/move orders.

rules.name: Nano Forest
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} construction turrets.

rules.name: Seaplane Gambit
rules.desc: Player ordered a seaplane platform on a map with water.

rules.name: Stealth Mode
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} radar jammers/stealth structures.

rules.name: Builder Swarm
rules.desc: Player queued >= {k} construction units.

rules.name: Late Shift
rules.desc: Player's last command came >= {k} minutes after their last build order: a pure fighting endgame.

rules.name: Busy to the End
rules.desc: Player issued an order in the last {k} s before the game ended.

rules.name: Steady Hands
rules.desc: Player's actions per minute stayed within ±{k}% in every 5-minute window of a >= 30 min game.

rules.name: Second Wind
rules.desc: Player's actions per minute in the last third of the game are >= {k}x the first third.

rules.name: Cancel Culture
rules.desc: Player issued >= {k} stop orders.

rules.name: Firing Squad
rules.desc: Player issued attack orders on >= {k} distinct units in one minute.

rules.name: Ground Pounder
rules.desc: Player issued >= {k} attack-ground orders.

rules.name: Area Denial
rules.desc: Player issued >= {k} area-attack orders.

rules.name: Airlift Minute
rules.desc: Player gave >= {k} transport load/unload commands in a single minute.

rules.name: Trickle Feeder
rules.desc: Player issued no factory queue orders for the last {k} minutes of a game >= 30 min.

rules.name: Fast Hands, Big Bucks
rules.desc: Player had both the highest actions per minute and the most metal produced in a game of >= {k} players.

rules.name: Built It, Won It
rules.desc: The player with the most build orders on the winning side also had the most units produced in the game (a winning side of >= {k} players).

rules.name: Commander's Last Order
rules.desc: A player's final command was a self-destruct of their commander, then they left.

rules.name: Defiant
rules.desc: A side voted no to resigning, kept playing >= {k} minutes, and lost anyway.

rules.name: Early Retirement
rules.desc: A side resigned before {k}:00 in a game of >= 6 players.

rules.name: Pause and Plan
rules.desc: After a pause of >= 30 s, the pausing player's side issued >= {k}x their usual commands in the next minute.

rules.name: Swift Surrender
rules.desc: The game ended within {k} minutes of the losing side's first resign vote, in a game >= 30 min.

rules.name: Build Order Copycat
rules.desc: In a team game, two allies ordered an identical first {k} builds.

rules.name: Geothermal Prospector
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} geothermal plants.

rules.name: Tidal Farm
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} tidal generators.

rules.name: Storage Wars
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} metal or energy storages.

rules.name: Airport Tycoon
rules.desc: Player ordered >= {k} air factories (T1/T2 combined).

rules.name: Shipyard Sprawl
